hook_zh: 中性色也有冷暖：灰、米、駝放上色環
caption_zh:
【AI 虛擬角色】本篇由 AI 生成的虛擬角色「色環」發布，圖像為 AI 生成，並非真人。
灰、米、駝色看起來都很「中性」，放上色環就會發現：有的偏暖，有的偏冷。
這篇用三組搭配示意圖比較冷暖並置的差別，只談顏色之間的對比，不談誰適合。
先收藏起來，搭配時可以對照～
螢幕有色差，實際顏色以品牌提供的資訊為準。
caption_gloss_en:
[AI virtual character] This post is published by the AI-generated virtual character "Sehuan"; the images are AI-generated and are not a real person.
Grey, beige and camel all look "neutral", but placed on the colour wheel you see that some lean warm and some lean cool.
This post compares warm and cool neutrals side by side in three styling illustrations. It only discusses contrast between colours, not who something suits.
Save it and compare when you put outfits together~
Screens shift colour; for the real colour, go by the information the brand provides.
on_screen_label_zh: AI 生成｜虛擬角色（有色環的頁面）／AI 生成（純圖解的頁面）

sources.claim: NO FACTUAL CLAIM: warm and cool lean of a neutral is described as a design convention, by comparing the neutral swatches with the wheel in the editor file; it is about garments and swatches only, never about skin. Hue positions are read from the hex values by the operator in the editor. If the operator logs a colour-theory reference (gate G7) that defines warm and cool colours, add it here and on slide 7.

CHANGE only: the angle. Show the same woman in a three-quarter view, her body and head turned about 40 degrees toward the viewer's left, eyes still looking at the camera. The tucked ear and its colour-wheel earring are clearly visible. Waist-up: the frame ends at the waist and both hands are outside the picture below the frame, arms relaxed. Same outfit (A), same hair, same calm closed-mouth expression.
OUTPUT: 4:5 portrait; plain dusty-blush seamless studio background; same soft studio light from the front right; one image.
